name: Garreth the Strong
description: A burly warrior with a scarred face and a heavy broadsword.

name: Elara the Wise
description: A robed figure with eyes that crackle with arcane energy.

name: Finn the Quick
description: A shadowy figure, barely visible in the dim light. You check your pockets.

name: Brother Thomas
description: A kindly priest with a warm smile and a heavy mace.

name: Lila the Songbird
description: She carries a lute and has a twinkle in her eye.

name: Arin of the Woods
description: Clad in green and brown, with a longbow slung over his shoulder.

name: Sir Alistair
description: His armor shines with a holy light. He looks very self-righteous.

name: Krog the Smasher
description: He wears little armor and carries a massive axe. He looks angry.

name: Master Wu
description: He stands perfectly still, yet looks ready to strike at any moment.

name: Barnaby the Rich
description: Dressed in fine silks, he looks out of place in a dungeon.
